description: Canonical effect text per ability head shape, derived from the printings that carry reminder text and applied to ALL printings of that shape. Reminder text is a printing decision, not a card property (907 of 1,228 Equip printings omit it), so expanding only where printed would split one concept into two vectors. {cost} is substituted with the ability's actual cost. Evergreen bare keywords are deliberately absent: expanding 'Flying' drops its self-match from 1.000 to 0.479, below the noise floor.
